themedReading_imageOptionalHint: No image model is configured. You can still generate a layout without new images.
themedReading_usageMissing: Usage was not recorded for this task
themedReading_removed: Reading page deleted; source content preserved
themedReading_stylePlaceholder: Leave blank for AI to choose. For example: a beer handbook in amber and cream, emphasizing concept comparisons.
themedReading_imageCost: Generate and display at least one themed image, up to the selected limit. Image requests may incur charges; cancellation cannot recall submitted requests.
themedReading_noImageCost: Redesign the page and reuse existing images without making new image-generation requests.
themedReading_configureHint: Configure the models required for this generation first.
themedReading_backgroundHint: You can switch articles or close this panel. Check progress in the processing center later.
themedReading_deleteHint: The current page, previous version, and dedicated generated assets will be removed. Source content and original images remain.
themedReading_emptyTasks: No reading page tasks yet. Select AI page in an article body or discussion summary to begin.
themedReading_readerEditSwitched: The article changed. Return to it and try saving again.
themedReading_readerEditConflict: The original changed while you were editing. Keep your draft before reloading.
themedReading_readerEditUnsaved: Your edits have not been saved. Please try again.
themedReading_readerNoReferences: This version uses no external references.
themedReading_readerStaleDetail: The original has changed. This page keeps the content used when it was generated. You can generate a new version from the latest original.
themedReading_readerReadOnly: This item is in the trash. You can still read and export its reading page.
themedReading_readerStale: The original has changed. This reading page keeps its earlier content.
themedReading_readerLegacyReadOnly: This reading page uses a legacy format and is read-only. You can still read and export it; generate a new version to make changes.
themedReading_readerEmpty: Another way to read this article
themedReading_readerEmptyHint: AI can organize the structure, explain key points, and design a reading layout. The original stays available.
themedReading_readerSetupHint: Organize the structure and explain key points in a layout suited to this article. The original and existing reading version stay available.
themedReading_readerResearchHint: Look for sources that support the article. Missing evidence triggers additional research; unresolved gaps pause generation.
themedReading_readerOfflineHint: Generate from existing content without retrieving new online sources.
themedReading_readerSearchMissing: Configure a search service first, or turn off online research.
themedReading_readerUpdating: Updating. You can keep reading the existing version.
themedReading_readerSourceSafe: The original is saved and remains available to read.
themedReading_readerLegacyTask: Tasks in the legacy format can no longer be continued. You can generate a new reading page instead.
themedReading_readerCopyFailed: Copy failed. Select the text above and copy it manually.
themedReading_readerViewFailed: Could not create the reading view
themedReading_saveEditFirst: Your current edits aren't saved yet. Save them, then try again.

settings_networkProxyModeDesc: Used by network features such as AI requests, web and video capture, model service connections, and update checks

settings_networkProxyAuthDesc: Leave username and password empty if your proxy does not require authentication
settings_networkProxyBypassDesc: Separate rules with commas, for example <local>,localhost,127.0.0.1
settings_launchAtStartupDesc: Automatically run GuiZhi when system starts
settings_minimizeOnLaunchDesc: Stay in the tray when launched at login; opening the app manually always shows the window
settings_closeActionDesc: Action when clicking the close button
settings_autoSaveDesc: Automatically save changes while editing; when off, save with the button or Ctrl+S
settings_backgroundImageDesc: Pick a local image and turn it into your desktop background, give GuiZhi a workspace feel that fits you, keep the actual file in GuiZhi's image library, and save only a lightweight reference in settings for easier backup and migration.
settings_backgroundImageSaveFailed: Could not save the selected background image. Please try another file.
settings_backgroundImageEnabledHint: Background image is currently enabled for the desktop shell.
settings_backgroundImageDisabledHint: Background image is saved but currently disabled.
settings_customColorDesc: Pick any color and apply it globally
settings_motion_desc: Control how much animation the desktop renderer plays. 'System' follows the system 'reduce motion' setting; 'Standard' always plays full animation.
settings_openLogsHint: Background task failures are recorded in error.log here
settings_enableNotificationsDesc: Allow app to send desktop notifications
settings_autoUpdateCheckFailed: Automatic update check failed. You can check manually in About.
settings_homebrewUpdateHint: This GuiZhi build was installed via Homebrew. Please upgrade it with Homebrew instead of the in-app DMG updater.
settings_homebrewUpdateRequired: This GuiZhi build appears to be installed via Homebrew. Please run 'brew upgrade --cask guizhi' instead of using the in-app updater.
settings_manualDownloadHint: Auto-update failed? You can manually download the latest version:
settings_installRestartHint: Installing will close the app and start the installer.
settings_autoCheckUpdateDesc: Automatically check for new versions on startup
settings_mirrorSourceRisk: When enabled, update checks and installer downloads go through third-party GitHub mirrors—useful when GitHub is slow or unstable. Mirrors are not officially maintained; keep this off if you can reach GitHub directly. Does not affect AI, capture, or other network features.
settings_supportPolicyDesc: Official support is for Windows 11+ x64. Linux / macOS can be built from source without compatibility guarantees.
settings_userGuideDesc: Learn how to use GuiZhi, configure models, and check known limitations
settings_changelogDesc: Review new features, fixes, and upgrade notes for each release
settings_productOverviewLocalDesc: Knowledge and backups are stored on your device. When you use remote AI, relevant content is sent to the selected service.
settings_productOverviewCaptureDesc: Capture web pages, major platforms, and local media into searchable knowledge.
settings_productOverviewAiDesc: Create summaries and tags, explore materials with AI reading and cited answers, and connect knowledge through Wiki.
settings_projectRepositoryDesc: Browse GuiZhi source code and releases on GitHub
settings_reportIssueDesc: Submit issues or suggestions on GitHub
settings_softMemoDescription: Discover useful apps, extensions, and scripts to find the right digital tools for you.
settings_visitSoftMemo: Visit the SoftMemo website (opens in your browser)
settings_aiWorkbenchProviderTypeHint: Uses {type} protocol preset and endpoint rules.
settings_fillApiFirst: Please fill in API Key and URL first
settings_confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this model?
settings_aiWorkbenchApiUrlGuide: Enter the provider base URL or version root only. GuiZhi will append the final request path automatically. If you want to preserve the exact address you entered, add # at the end and GuiZhi will stop appending any path in both the saved URL and request preview.
settings_aiWorkbenchApiUrlDetectedFullEn: A full endpoint path was detected. GuiZhi will normalize it to the base URL on blur/save.
settings_fillComplete: Please fill in all required fields
settings_aiWorkbenchNoModels: No models configured yet. Add a provider first, then add chat, embedding, or transcription models.
settings_aiWorkbenchModelCapabilitiesHin: A regular chat model needs no checkboxes — it already covers Q&A, summaries, transcript formatting, and other text tasks.
settings_aiWorkbenchVisionCapabilityDesc: Can read images and screenshots for OCR and multimodal understanding.
settings_aiWorkbenchReasoningCapabilityD: Marks this as a thinking model for easier identification; does not change how requests are made.
settings_aiWorkbenchEmbeddingCapabilityD: Produces vectors for semantic search. Marks this as a dedicated model excluded from chat.
settings_aiWorkbenchTranscriptionCapabil: Transcribes audio/video via /audio/transcriptions, e.g. whisper-1. Marks the model as dedicated — excluded from chat.
settings_aiWorkbenchImageGenCapabilityDe: Draws images from a prompt, e.g. gpt-image-2 or gemini-3-pro-image. Marks the model as dedicated — excluded from chat. The connection test really draws one smallest-size image, which is billed.
settings_aiWorkbenchRouteMainTextDesc: Strong default chat model for knowledge Q&A, wiki compilation, and video/audio summaries.
settings_aiWorkbenchRouteFastTextDesc: Low-cost chat model for summaries, auto-tagging, transcript formatting, and lightweight tasks.
settings_aiWorkbenchRouteVisionTextDesc: Vision-capable chat model for image OCR and multimodal understanding.
settings_aiWorkbenchLegacyBannerDesc: Your existing AI features still work, but the new workbench needs that config imported into the multi-model list.
settings_aiUsageEmpty: No AI calls recorded in the last {days} days
settings_aiUsageNoTokens: This endpoint does not report token usage; only call counts are tracked
settings_aiWorkbenchFetchModelsUnsupport: This provider did not return a compatible model list endpoint. You can still enter the model ID manually.
settings_aiWorkbenchFetchModelsNetworkEr: Could not reach the model list endpoint. Check API URL, network, proxy, or CORS policy.
settings_aiWorkbenchFetchModelsAuthError: The model list request was rejected. Check your API key and provider permissions.
settings_aiWorkbenchFetchModelsEmpty: The provider returned no models. If it hides the list endpoint, enter the model ID manually.
settings_aiWorkbenchConnectionNetworkErr: Request failed before the provider responded. Check API URL, network, proxy, or CORS policy.
settings_aiWorkbenchConnectionAuthError: The provider rejected this request. Check your API key, account permission, and endpoint path.
settings_aiWorkbenchCorsBlocked: Browser blocked this cross-origin request (CORS) while calling {target}. Enable CORS on the provider or use an app-side proxy.
settings_aiWorkbenchCorsBlockedDev: Browser blocked this cross-origin request (CORS). Current page {origin} cannot directly call {target}. Either enable CORS on the provider or route this request through the Electron main process.
settings_aiWorkbenchIncompleteModel: This model configuration is incomplete and cannot be tested
settings_aiWorkbenchEndpointNotTestable: No complete model under this endpoint can be tested yet
settings_aiWorkbenchConfirmDeleteProvide: Delete provider "{name}"? The {count} model configurations under it will be deleted as well, along with any model routes pointing to them.
settings_aiWorkbenchLocalEngineLocked: The built-in local transcription engine is not removed here. Uninstall it under Settings → Capture.
settings_aiWorkbenchLocalEngineManaged: The URL, the key and the model below are all configured automatically by the one-click install under Settings → Capture. The service listens on this machine only and needs no key.
settings_aiWorkbenchLocalEngineReadOnly: The built-in local transcription engine is maintained by the installer; editing it here breaks transcription. Manage it under Settings → Capture.
settings_aiWorkbenchNoDefaultModel: There is no default model available to test yet
settings_aiWorkbenchModelModalSubtitle: Saved changes take effect immediately and participate in scenario routing.
settings_aiWorkbenchAddProviderSubtitle: Configure the provider endpoint first. Models can be added under this provider later.
settings_aiWorkbenchEditEndpointSubtitle: This updates provider, API Key, and API URL for all models under the endpoint.
settings_shortcutShowAppDesc: Quickly bring up the app window from anywhere
settings_shortcutNewItemDesc: Open quick capture to create a new knowledge item
settings_shortcutModeDesc: Global shortcuts work from any app. Local shortcuts only work when GuiZhi is focused
settings_shortcutTip1: Click the input field and press your desired key combination
settings_shortcutTip2: Shortcuts must include a modifier key (Ctrl/Cmd/Alt/Shift) and a regular key
settings_shortcutTip3: Some shortcuts may conflict with system or other applications
settings_shortcutRegisterFailed: The system refused to register this shortcut; another app may already own it
settings_webUpdatesManagedDesc: Self-hosted web updates are managed by your deployment workflow. Pull the new version and redeploy the service instead of using in-app desktop updates.
settings_joinPreviewChannelDesc: Check both stable and preview releases and offer the newer version. Turn off to check stable releases only.
settings_previewChannelWarning: Preview builds may be unstable. Please back up your data before updating and use them mainly for testing new fixes.
settings_previewChannelConfirmSubtitle: Preview updates are opt-in. When enabled, GuiZhi receives whichever is newer between prerelease and stable — it will not stay on prereleases only.
settings_previewChannelConfirmRisk: Preview builds can include regressions, unfinished behavior, or migration edge cases that are not yet fully validated.
settings_previewChannelConfirmBackup: Before enabling this channel, create a manual backup or export so you can safely roll back if a preview build behaves unexpectedly.
settings_previewChannelConfirmConsent: Turn off the preview channel to receive stable updates only. If your preview version is newer than the latest stable release, GuiZhi will not downgrade automatically.
settings_platformBrowserUnavailable: GuiZhi's built-in sign-in window is unavailable
settings_platformLoggedOut: Signed out · uses GuiZhi's built-in official sign-in window
settings_platformClearDataDesc: Deletes only GuiZhi's built-in sign-in sessions; your knowledge base and everyday browser are unaffected
settings_platformClearConfirm: This removes Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and LINUX DO sign-in/verification data from GuiZhi's built-in sign-in windows. It cannot be undone, but does not affect your knowledge base or everyday browser.
settings_platformClearSuccess: Platform sign-in data cleared; Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and LINUX DO are now signed out
settings_platformLinuxdoLoggedOut: Not verified · complete Cloudflare verification before capture (sign in for private categories)
settings_wikiAutoCompileDesc: Compiles new items into the wiki every 5 minutes. Runs silently in the background and keeps consuming AI calls.
settings_captureCheckFailed: Update check failed, please try again later
settings_captureCustomPathHint: Takes precedence over the built-in copy and system PATH; for safety it can only be set through the file picker
settings_captureCustomInvalid: The custom path cannot be executed — check or clear it under advanced options
settings_ytDlpMissingHint: Required for capturing from Bilibili / YouTube
settings_ytDlpRemoveConfirm: Remove the built-in yt-dlp? Online video parsing will fall back to the system PATH; you can reinstall it at any time.
settings_ytDlpInstallDone: yt-dlp installed ({version}) — retry parsing from the capture tasks list
settings_ffmpegMissingHint: Converts audio to 16kHz mono for smaller, more compatible uploads
settings_ffmpegBrewHint: In-app install is not available on this platform; run {command} in Terminal, or pick a path in Advanced
settings_ffmpegPackageManagerHint: In-app install is not available on this platform; install via your package manager, or pick a path in Advanced
settings_ffmpegRemoveConfirm: Remove the built-in ffmpeg? Transcription will upload the original audio instead; you can reinstall it at any time.
settings_ffmpegInstallDone: ffmpeg installed ({version}) — audio will be compressed before transcription
settings_transcribeDiarizeDesc: Only worthwhile for multi-speaker material such as interviews and meetings: it doubles transcription time and requires the built-in local engine.
settings_transcribeDiarizeUnavailable: Speaker diarization requires the Windows Python local engine; Mac GGUF and cloud transcription do not support it.
settings_funasrUpdateDone: Local transcription engine updated to v{version}
settings_funasrUpdateStorage: Checking disk space and previous backups
settings_funasrUpdatePreparingHint: Confirming the version, reviewing previous backups and checking free space. The current engine has not been stopped.
settings_funasrUpdateBackupHint: Saving the previous version so it can be restored if the update fails. With many files, this step may take a few minutes.
settings_funasrUpdateDependenciesHint: Download time depends on your connection and the packages to update. Downloaded speech models will be kept.
settings_funasrUpdateVerifyHint: Checking dependencies and starting the engine to verify the update.
settings_funasrUpdateRollbackHint: The update did not complete. Restoring the previous engine; the result will appear when finished.
settings_funasrDiskHint: No upload, no per-minute billing; about 3GB of disk
settings_funasrDiskHintGguf: No upload, no per-minute billing; Apple Silicon, about 300MB of disk
settings_funasrUnsupportedHint: Local engine is not available on this platform; configure the audioText route under Model Services
settings_funasrPhaseDeps: Installing dependencies (about 700MB, takes a few minutes)
settings_funasrInstallDone: Local transcription engine installed and wired into the speech-to-text route
settings_funasrUninstallConfirm: Uninstall the local transcription engine? This removes the runtime and model files (about 3GB) and clears the speech-to-text route.
settings_funasrUninstallConfirmGguf: Uninstall the local transcription engine? This removes the runtime and model files (about 300MB) and clears the speech-to-text route.
settings_backupAutoDesc: Back up the knowledge base to the local backups folder on a schedule
settings_backupIntervalDesc: Runs when due while the app is running
settings_backupKeepDesc: Older automatic backups beyond this count are pruned; manual backups are kept
settings_backupEmpty: No backups yet. Click "Back up now" to create the first one.
settings_backupListFailed: Failed to read the backup list
settings_backupDeleteConfirmMessage: Delete backup {name}? This cannot be undone.
settings_backupRestoreConfirmMessage: All current data will be replaced with the backup from {time}. A snapshot of the current data is saved automatically before restoring. The app restarts when done.
settings_mcpLoadFailed: Failed to load MCP integration details.
settings_mcpDesc: Once connected, Cursor, Codex and other AI tools can search and read your knowledge base directly — no need to copy content out of GuiZhi first. GuiZhi does not have to be running, and only two read-only tools are exposed; nothing can be modified or deleted.
settings_mcpMissing: MCP server component not found. On a development build, run pnpm build first; on an installed build this means the package is incomplete — update or reinstall.
settings_mcpScopeDesc: The AI only sees collections allowed here. Changes take effect immediately, no IDE restart needed.
settings_mcpScopeAllDesc: Collections created later are included automatically
settings_mcpScopeSelectedDesc: Only ticked collections are visible to the AI
settings_mcpScopeEmptyWarning: Nothing is ticked: the AI will find nothing at all.
settings_mcpScopeSaveFailed: Failed to save the access scope
settings_mcpInstallHint: Merges GuiZhi into that client's config file. Your other MCP servers and any comments you wrote are kept, and a backup is saved before overwriting.
settings_mcpInstallWritten: Written to the {client} config — restart {client} to apply
settings_mcpInstallUpdated: Updated the GuiZhi entry in {client} — restart {client} to apply
settings_mcpSnippetCommand: Command line (recommended, writes the config for you)
settings_mcpSnippetToml: Or add it to config.toml by hand
settings_mcpCursorLocation: Global config lives at ~/.cursor/mcp.json; a project-level .cursor/mcp.json also works.
settings_mcpCursorPitfall: After editing the file by hand, refresh once in Cursor's MCP panel before it connects.
settings_mcpCodexLocation: Global config lives at ~/.codex/config.toml; a project-level .codex/config.toml only applies to trusted projects.
settings_mcpCodexPitfall: Codex uses TOML, and the key is mcp_servers with an underscore. Copying the JSON-style mcpServers makes the whole block silently ignored.
settings_exportMarkdownDesc: Exports all items as .md files with metadata, grouped by collection — ready for Obsidian and similar tools
settings_aiWorkbenchRouteEmbeddingDesc: Vector model for semantic search; without it, search falls back to full-text only.
settings_aiWorkbenchRouteAudioTextDesc: Speech-to-text model for audio/video (e.g. whisper-1, via /audio/transcriptions).
settings_aiWorkbenchRouteImageGenDesc: Text-to-image model for article illustrations and AI reading page assets (e.g. gpt-image-2, gemini-3-pro-image).
settings_autoBackupRunning: Auto backup in progress; the app may briefly stop responding…
settings_configExportDesc: Writes every app setting to a single JSON file: AI endpoints and models, model routes, shortcuts, appearance and general preferences. API keys can be encrypted and included.
settings_configExportSubtitle: Write this device's entire configuration to a JSON file, then import it on the new machine.
settings_configExportIncludeKeysDesc: When off, only endpoint URLs, names and routes are exported; keys are left blank and must be filled in after importing.
settings_configExportPasswordHint: Keys are encrypted with this password before being written; the rest of the file stays readable plain text. The password is only needed at import time — GuiZhi never stores it and cannot recover it.
settings_configExportPasswordTooShort: Password must be at least {count} characters
settings_configExportScopeNote: Not included: data directory, yt-dlp and ffmpeg paths, launch at startup, background image, and the local transcription engine — those are bound to this machine. Knowledge items travel via Local backup instead.
settings_configImportDesc: Restore settings from a configuration file exported on another device. You'll see a summary of the file's contents before anything is replaced.
settings_configImportRowKeysAbsent: Not included — fill them in after importing
settings_configImportWarning: Every setting on this machine will be replaced by this file, including configured API keys. A snapshot of the config directory is taken first. The app restarts once the import finishes.
settings_configImportRowMcpAbsent: Not in the file; this device keeps its current setting
settings_backgroundTasksDesc: Let auto backup, Wiki and semantic indexing keep running when GuiZhi starts hidden at login or stays in the tray.
settings_backgroundTasksConfirmMessage: GuiZhi will launch at login, start hidden, minimize to the tray, and keep running in the background when you close the window. You can still quit from the tray menu; tasks stop once it quits.
settings_fullBackupLoadFailed: Failed to load the full backup repository
settings_fullBackupPasswordHint: At least 12 characters; both entries must match before you can enable it.
settings_fullBackupInitFailed: Failed to set up the backup repository
settings_fullBackupCreated: Full backup created: {created} new objects, {reused} reused
settings_fullBackupRestored: Full restore complete. The app is restarting…
settings_fullBackupExportFailed: Failed to export the portable backup
settings_fullBackupPasswordChangeFailed: Failed to change the recovery password
settings_fullBackupPasswordChanged: Recovery password changed; media objects don't need to be rewritten
settings_fullBackupIntroTitle: Back up knowledge, media and settings together
settings_fullBackupIntroDesc: Media is deduplicated by content and fully encrypted. The recovery password is never stored on this device; if you lose it and the system keyring is unavailable, the backup can't be restored.
settings_fullBackupKeyringReady: System keyring ready ({backend}); backups can run unattended.
settings_fullBackupUnlockPlaceholder: Recovery password (new device or no keyring)
settings_fullBackupNoSnapshotsImportHint: Restoring from another device: enter the portable backup's recovery passphrase, then choose Import portable backup.
settings_fullBackupImportTitle: Have a portable backup? (restore on a new device)
settings_fullBackupImportDesc: Enter the recovery passphrase you set when backing up, then choose the .guizhi-backup file. Importing only adds it to the list; your current data is replaced only after you choose Pre-check and restore.
settings_fullBackupImportPasswordLabel: Recovery passphrase of the portable backup
settings_fullBackupImportNeedPassword: Enter the recovery passphrase of this portable backup first
settings_fullBackupImportExisted: This portable backup is already in the local repository
settings_fullBackupImported: Portable backup imported. Your current data is replaced only after you choose Pre-check and restore
settings_fullBackupImportReplacedDetail: The local backup repository had no snapshots, so it was replaced by the one from this portable backup. Use its recovery passphrase from now on.
settings_fullBackupRestoreConfirmMessage: This restores {items} knowledge items, {assets} media files and {domains} settings domains. The pre-check passed; this device's paths and startup preferences are kept.
settings_fullBackupDeleteMessage: This deletes the snapshot manifest and reclaims encrypted objects that no other snapshot uses. This can't be undone.
settings_quickSetupBasicDesc: Main text + fast text models, the minimum for Q&A
settings_quickSetupAudioDesc: Turn audio and video into searchable text
settings_quickSetupNeedEndpoint: Enter the API URL and key. For a local service without auth, enter local
settings_quickSetupNoModels: No models were returned; you can also enter model names in the next step
settings_quickSetupModelRequired: Choose or enter a model for every capability
settings_quickSetupSaveFailed: Save failed; your existing settings are unchanged: {message}
settings_quickSetupManualModels: The model list is unavailable, so you can enter models manually. You can still test each one before saving.
settings_quickSetupTestHint: You can skip testing; those capabilities are marked “Unverified”. Image-generation models are not connection-tested (a real image would be billed) and stay marked “Unverified”.
settings_readingSearchDefaultSaved: Default web search setting for reading pages saved
settings_readingSearchDefaultFailed: Could not save the default setting
settings_readingSearchDesc: Finds references for AI reading and questions about an article. Only research keywords are sent. The connection test runs one search and saves the settings if it passes.
settings_readingSearchDefault: Search the web by default when generating reading pages
settings_readingSearchDefaultDesc: Off by default, so pages are generated from existing content only. When on, supporting sources are searched by default; you can still change this for each generation.
settings_readingSearchNativeMissing: Configure a main text model in Model Services first
settings_readingSearchNativeHint: Reuses your Model Services credentials, so no separate search key is needed. Test whether the service supports web search first. Searches consume model and tool usage; if a search fails, retry or switch search services.
settings_readingSearchKeyReplace: Configured. Enter a new key to replace it
settings_readingSearchSessionOnly: This system can only keep it for the current session
common_colorSaturationBrightness: Saturation and brightness, adjustable with arrow keys
common_unsavedChangesMessage: You have unsaved changes. Save them?
error_sha512Desc:
SHA512 checksum mismatch.
This is usually caused by CDN cache inconsistencies or network issues.
The file may have been downloaded successfully. You can try to install it manually.
closeDialog_message: Would you like to close the app or minimize to system tray?
library_columnConfigHint: Click to show or hide a column
library_selectPageRows: Select all rows on this page
library_deleteForeverConfirm: This item will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.
library_deleteForeverConfirmMany: The {count} selected items will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.
library_emptyTrashConfirm: All items in the trash will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.
library_listEmpty: No items yet. Use “New” in the top-right corner to start.
library_noSelection: Select an item on the left, or create one to start writing
library_commentsLoadedEmpty: No comments retrieved. Try again later.
library_aiHandoffCopied: Copied {size} characters, ready to paste into an AI tool
library_aiHandoffCopiedBrief: Copied brief version, {size} characters ({omitted} characters of long text omitted)
library_aiHandoffEmpty: This item has no content to hand off to an AI
library_noPlatforms: Grouped by source once you capture pages or videos
library_showUnusedTags: Show {count} unused tag(s) — delete them from the row menu
library_collectionDeleted: Deleted collection "{name}"; its items were kept
library_tagDeleted: Deleted tag "{name}"; related items were kept
library_aiSummaryEmpty: Content is empty, nothing to summarize
library_aiSummaryTruncated: AI summary generated, but the model hit its output length limit — it may be incomplete
library_forumReplyJumpMiss: That floor is not in the library or cannot be located
library_forumDiscussionRefreshedSummaryS: Discussion refreshed; the previous summary is marked as outdated
library_ocrNoTextRecognized: No text was extracted from any image
library_transcribeRunning: Transcribing (this may take a few minutes)…
library_transcriptEmpty: No transcript yet. Generate one to enable QA retrieval and video summaries.
library_transcribeOneSpeaker: Transcript generated, but only one speaker was detected
library_transcriptFormatNotConfigured: No usable text model configured yet
library_transcriptFormatLongConfirm: This transcript is about {chars} characters. Formatting splits it into {chunks} sequential model requests, which may take several minutes and incur usage. Continue?
library_mediaSummaryDone: Summary added to the note body
library_mediaSummaryNotConfigured: No usable text model configured (video summary uses the mainText route)
library_bulkAddTagHint: Add a tag to the {count} selected item(s)
library_reviewRequiredHint: Usable content was kept, but the capture found the gaps below. Mark it as reviewed once you have checked it.
library_draftConflict: This content was changed elsewhere. Your draft hasn't overwritten the saved version.
library_smartViewSaveCurrent: Save current filters as a smart view
library_sourceRevisionsHint: Newly captured content is kept here and your edited text stays unchanged. Review it, then adopt it explicitly.
library_sourceRevisionAdopt: Use this version's text in the draft
library_snapshotLoadFailed: Could not load the web snapshot
library_snapshotExportedIncomplete: Exported, but some resources are missing
library_snapshotMissing: No web snapshot saved yet. Showing the standard layout.
library_snapshotOriginalHint: You're viewing the snapshot taken at capture time. It doesn't include your edits.
library_snapshotEditedHint: Showing your edited text. The original snapshot still keeps the captured content.
library_snapshotPendingVersion: A newer source version is available. Compare and adopt it under “Source versions”.
library_workflowBoundary: Reached the end of this review range
library_workflowFrozen: Selection locked ({count}); items added later won't be included
library_workflowNoResult: No result returned for this item
library_workflowSelectionCleared: Filters changed, so the previous cross-page selection was cleared
library_deleteEvidenceHint: Past answers keep the excerpts they cited by default. The option below only clears related evidence and links; the answer text stays unchanged.
library_deleteEvidenceClear: Also clear related evidence from past Q&A
migration_detected: Found a legacy GuiZhi database ({count} knowledge items).
migration_scope: One-click migration covers items, collections, tags, source records and wiki pages. The original file stays untouched.
migration_doneStats: {items} items · {collections} collections · {tags} tags · {sources} sources · {wikiPages} wiki pages
setup_intro: You can capture and run full-text search without any model. Set up a text model to unlock summaries, Q&A and Wiki.
setup_itemTextModelDesc: Q&A, summaries, Wiki compile and video summaries all need it.
setup_itemTranscription: Turn video and audio into text
setup_itemTranscriptionDesc: Install the local transcription engine, or pick a cloud transcription model under Model Services.
setup_itemEmbeddingDesc: Full-text search works without it. With it, Q&A finds sources by meaning, not just matching keywords.
setup_openFromAboutDesc: Review the text model and other setup items again
wiki_compileUpToDate: Every item is already in the wiki
wiki_panelOrphanHint: Orphan pages are not linked from anywhere — usually the loose edges of the knowledge network.
wiki_panelGraphHint: Browse by node in graph view
wiki_noSelection: Select a page on the left
